What are some factors that influence physical health among veterans

```{r}
brfss = read.csv("brfss2022_m62.csv", stringsAsFactors=TRUE)
```

```{r Physical Health: Heart Disease}
#| echo: false
veteran <- subset(brfss, veteran == "Yes")

# Two lines below generated by Gemini, prompt was that given these columns, drop any rows where any of these columns are NA
# Define the variables of interest
vars <- c("heartdisease", "sex", "bmi", "cancer", "copd", 
          "daysphyshlthnotgood", "anyexer", "race", 
          "age", "bingedrinker", "weeklydrinks")

# Subset rows where all specified columns are non-NA
veteran_physical <- veteran[complete.cases(veteran[, vars]), ]


model_heartdiease <- glm(formula = heartdisease ~ sex + bmi + cancer + copd +
                 daysphyshlthnotgood + anyexer + race +
                 age + bingedrinker + weeklydrinks , data=veteran_physical, family=binomial)

#The two lines below are Gemini generated: Prompt was that given a glm model, create automatic stepwise param selection
# Perform stepwise selection using AIC
# direction = "both" checks for variables to add AND remove at each step
final_model_heartdisease <- step(model_heartdiease, direction = "both")

# View the final selected model
summary(final_model_heartdisease)

```
```{r Physical Health: Cancer}
#| echo: false

model_cancer <- glm(formula = cancer ~ sex + bmi  + copd +
                 daysphyshlthnotgood + anyexer + race +
                 age + bingedrinker + weeklydrinks , data=veteran_physical, family=binomial)

#The two lines below are Gemini generated: Prompt was that given a glm model, create automatic stepwise param selection
# Perform stepwise selection using AIC
# direction = "both" checks for variables to add AND remove at each step
final_model_cancer <- step(model_cancer)

# View the final selected model
summary(final_model_cancer)

```

What are some factors that influence mental health among veterans

```{r Mental Health: Depression}
#| echo: false

# Two lines below generated by Gemini, prompt was that given these columns, drop any rows where any of these columns are NA
# Define the variables of interest

vars_mental <- c("daysmenthlthnotgood", "medcost", "income", "race", "age", "bingedrinker", "weeklydrinks", "sex", "depress")

# Subset rows where all specified columns are non-NA
veteran_mental <- veteran[complete.cases(veteran[, vars_mental]), ]


model_depression <- glm(formula = depress ~ sex + medcost + income + race +
                 age + bingedrinker + weeklydrinks + daysmenthlthnotgood , data=veteran_mental, family=binomial)

#The two lines below are Gemini generated: Prompt was that given a glm model, create automatic stepwise param selection
# Perform stepwise selection using AIC
# direction = "both" checks for variables to add AND remove at each step
final_model_depression <- step(model_depression, direction = "both")

# View the final selected model
summary(final_model_depression)

```


```{r Mental Health: Daysmenthlthnotgood}
#| echo: false

# Two lines below generated by Gemini, prompt was that given these columns, drop any rows where any of these columns are NA

model_daysmenthlthnotgood<- lm(formula = daysmenthlthnotgood ~ sex + medcost + income + race +
                 age + bingedrinker + weeklydrinks + depress , data=veteran_mental)

#The two lines below are Gemini generated: Prompt was that given a glm model, create automatic stepwise param selection
# Perform stepwise selection using AIC
# direction = "both" checks for variables to add AND remove at each step
final_model_daysmenthlthnotgood <- step(model_daysmenthlthnotgood, direction = "both")

# View the final selected model
summary(final_model_daysmenthlthnotgood)

```
